events.caption: proposes to stop the adhoc_reporting job.

detail.rationale: The root blocker pid 13162 is an idle-in-transaction batch worker (adhoc_reporting) holding locks for 4.0s while 12 sessions wait and checkout suffers 55% success rate with 27 timeouts in 15s (DB-1, TEL-2). Terminating this single session releases its locks immediately, unblocking the 12 waiters and allowing checkout to recover. The workload is a batch worker, likely replayable, and the cost of waiting (ongoing checkout failures) far exceeds the cost of interrupting a reporting job.
